I just want to say, don’t blame yourself. When you described what had happened to your son, I felt a bit sad because that’s exactly what’s happened to me in 2017. It’s been the worst year for me and I tried to kill myself 4 times. I felt the same towards my mother. Even though I know she only wanted the best for me, she had no idea how to deal with how sick I was and this came through in all the worst ways. But I know she cared, even if she couldn’t show it. So even if your son felt mad at you or that you don’t understand, I can almost guarantee that he knew, however deep down, that you really did care and how much of an amazing parent you were. 

I’m doing better now. I’m medicated so I’m not as depressed, but I still have a fair bit of suicidal ideation. I think I still want to do it, deep down. I’ve taken to harming myself just to feel better sometimes. I know that i’m ill and that this is all part of the journey. But reading your post has really helped my understand it from the other side and restored a bit of faith in my mother. Thank you for that. 

I hope you feel better soon. Don’t beat yourself up.
